Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J
1. Mr. M.C. Pant, learned counsel for
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned Standing
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. According to petitioner, he was
appointed as Assistant Teacher (General)
on ad-hoc basis against the substantive
vacancy in Kishan Higher Secondary
School, Badhbalpur, District Haridwar on
18.07.1994. His services were
subsequently regularised w.e.f.
22.04.2006, vide order dated
30.05.2007.
4. Petitioner contends that since his
date of regularisation was altered to
30.09.2005, vide order dated
18.01.2025 passed by Regional
Additional Director, Pauri, therefore, he is
entitled to benefit of Old Pension
Schem e. Since such benefit is not given
to petitioner, therefore, he has
approached this Court, seeking the
following relief: -
(i) I ssue writ rule or direction in the nature of
mandam us by directing the respondent to
allow the benefit of old pension schem e to
the petitioner in view of his entitlement as
per his amended date of regularization i.e.
on 30.09.2025 with all consequential
benefits and to release his all retiral dues in
respect of old pension scheme and gratuity
with arrears together with interest or to
mould the relief appropriately by
safeguarding the interest of the petitioner
keeping in view the fact highlighted in the

2025:UHC:10257
body of the petition.
5. Since petitioner has sought a writ of
m andamus and he has not made any
representation, therefore, writ petition is
disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
m ake representation to the Com petent
Authority, highlighting his grievance. I f
he m akes representation within two
weeks from today, decision thereupon
shall be taken by the Com petent
Authority, as per law, within four m onths
thereafter.
 ( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J)
